chapter.verse: Tu-in nisuahna lam Jordan galkhat, Arnon kuam panin nisuahna lam Arabah khempeuh tawh Hermon Mual ciang dong Israel mite in a leitang uh laksakin a zawh mite’ gam kumpite in:

Heshbon-ah a teeng Amor kumpi, Arnon kuam gei-a a om Aroer pan, leh Gilead gam laizang panin phel lang ahi Ammon mite gamgi Jabbok gun ciang dong, leh Arabah panin, nisuahna lamah Khinneroth Tuipi, leh Bethjeshimoth lamah Pisgah mual pang bul leitaw lama om Ci Tuipi ahi Arabah tuipi ciang dong a uk Sihon;

leh Bashan kumpi, Refaim panin a suaktate lakah khat, Ashtaroth leh Edrei-ah teengin, Hermon Mual leh Salekah leh Bashan khempeuh panin Geshur mite leh Ma-aketh mite gamgi ciang, leh Gilead lang khat panin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon’ gamgi ciang dong a uk, Og ahi hi.
Topa ’ nasem Moses leh Israel mite in amaute zo uh hi; tua ciangin Topa ’ nasem Moses in Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh minam a langte tungah a neih dingun amau’ leitang a pia hi.

Hihte in, Joshua leh Israel mite in a zawh Jordan nitumna lam pang, Lebanon kuam sung Baalgad panin Seir lamah a kikhung to Jakah Mual kikala om tua gam kumpite ahi hi (Joshua in mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Arabah gam, mual pang suk, gamlak, leh Negeb gam sunga om Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite, leitangte Israel minamte tungah amau' ngah ding tawh kizui-in a neih dingun pia hi);
